title: Firecrawl API key (fc-): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: _x glued after the body, boundary: x glued before fc-, and separators: fc- + a dashed UUID, which is not an issued form. Twin of "Firecrawl API key (fc-): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of firecrawl-api-key-bare-prose: boundary: x glued before fc-. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
